unresolved.question: `Include Resolved Claims`: the effect is not documented; the research document only infers that it adds closed claims and that by default only unresolved claims are listed.

Older build: the vendor's 2011 sample footer echoes `Provider : ALL`, but the current criteria have no PROVIDER picker. An older build apparently filtered Claims List by provider; it is NOT added because the current screen (captured complete) does not have it. Whether the filter was removed or is only hidden in the current build is not documented.

`CLAIM TYPE` (`Both` / `Dental` / `Medical`) on Claims List, Claims Created Not Sent and Outstanding Claims: that it filters dental versus medical claims is inferred (on Outstanding Claims the research document only presumes a separate `Medical Claims` band).
`Show Billing Provider For Hygienist`: not documented; taken (inferred) to print the billing provider instead of a hygienist in the provider column.

`FACILITY ID`: the vendor sample header prints `Facility ID : <value>`; that the criteria text box supplies that header line (the carrier's id for the office) is inferred. The basis of `DATE RANGE` (transaction date of the procedures) is also inferred from the sample.
`Fee Schedule To Compare`: which fee schedules the list contains (all of the practice or only those of the selected office), their order and the rule for the pre-selected entry are not documented.

`REPORT FORMAT` = `Summary`: what it changes is not documented (the vendor sample and the old report name `Capitation Utilization - Detail` cover Detail only). `GROUP BY` = `Provider`: taken (inferred) to add a provider level.
Whether PRINT FORMAT = Excel also greys GROUP BY on Capitation Utilization and on Claims Created Not Sent, as it does on Outstanding Claims, is not documented.

No vendor article names this report. Open: the date basis of CREATED ON DATE RANGE (date the claim was created is our reading), whether the other criteria behave as on Claims List (inferred) and what GROUP BY = Provider does (a provider level is inferred). Also unverified: whether a claim saved with `E-Claim` (ledger text `Recreated` instead of `Created, Not Sent`) is included.
Whether `DATE RANGE` is the date of service or the transaction date is unverified.

`On Hold`: that ticking it limits the report to requests flagged On Hold on the verification form is inferred; `Include patients with no insurance` (adds appointments of patients with no plan attached) is inferred too. The report itself is not described by the vendor.

`DATE RANGE TYPE`: the non-default states (Appointment Created Date, Both) are not shown by the vendor. That they enable the greyed APPOINTMENT CREATED DATE RANGE inputs, and which range each choice disables, remains an inference from our screenshot.
The basis of `DATE RANGE` (payment date) is inferred.

Older build / unseen mode: Recall mode was not captured, and its criteria are known only from an older build: the footer of the vendor's 2011 Recall sample (then the separate report `Benefits Used/Unused - Recall`) echoes three criteria that the Treatment Plan state does not have - `Recall Date From / Thru`, `Max Over` and `Recall Codes`. They are NOT added as controls: the current Recall screen is unverified, and the footer wording gives neither the section titles nor the on-screen labels, control types, value lists or defaults. To settle: capture the screen with TREATMENT PLAN/RECALL = Recall and record which criteria appear, change or disappear.
`EXCLUDE RESPONSIBLE PARTY TYPE`: the value list of the picker is not documented.

OTHER OPTIONS `Current` / `Over 30` / `Over 60` / `Over 90` / `Over 120`: that they choose which age buckets are included is inferred. Also unknown: the age basis (claim sent date or date of service) and whether `Report Date` reconstructs history or only shifts the aging.

`GROUP BY` = `Provider`: taken (inferred) to add a provider grouping level. Vendor material still uses the old report name `Outstanding Claim Report for Provider`; mapping it to this option is inferred.

`REPORT DATE`: that `DOS Date` / `Transaction Date` enable the single Report Date input (and that `ALL` means every unclaimed procedure) comes from our own screenshot; the vendor documents only single-day use. `CLAIM TYPE` Primary / Secondary / Tertiary / Quaternary (coverage levels whose missing claims are listed) is inferred.
The basis of `DATE RANGE` is unverified.

`Show Details UCR` (ticked by default): not documented; taken (unverified) to add service-line detail with the billed (UCR) amount. The meanings of `835 CLAIM MATCHING STATUS` (payment matched to a claim or not) and of `CLAIM STATUS` `Partial Closed` / `Closed` (claim state after posting) are inferred.

`EXCLUDE REASON CODE`: the effect (removes lines with the picked reason codes) is inferred and the value list of the picker is not documented (sample values suggest the standard 835 adjustment reason codes - inferred).
The report is not described by the vendor: what `CREATED ON DATE RANGE` filters (taken to be the date-time of the automatic eligibility check) is inferred.

ADD TO MY FAVORITES (action on every report): vendor training material says it saves the criteria - one version per report - and that a saved version is later changed with `Update My Favorites`. Where `Update My Favorites` appears (this button relabelled once the report is a favourite, or an action elsewhere) is not described in this document.

SELECT / SEARCH dialogs: apart from `Include All` (stated for the PROVIDER and CARRIER pickers and, generally, for all pickers) and the fact that one or more offices or an office group can be chosen, the contents of the office / office group, provider, carrier, responsible-party-type and reason-code dialogs and of the NAME RANGE SEARCH lookups are not described in this research document.
